data.question: Five former Soviet republics share the same ending, meaning 'land of'. Name all five.
data.explanation: Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan. The ending is -stan; Afghanistan and Pakistan were never Soviet.
data.answer_full: Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan. The ending is -stan; Afghanistan and Pakistan were never Soviet.
